title.zh: 卷450 列傳二百三十七 李鹤年 文彬 任道镕 许振祎 吴大澂
title.en: Volume 450 Biographies 237: Li Henian, Wen Bin, Ren Daorong, Xu Zhenyi, Wu Dacheng
title.raw: 卷450 列傳二百三十七 李鹤年 文彬 任道镕 许振祎 吴大澂

sentences.zh: 李鶴年，字子和，奉天義州人。

translations.literal: Li Henian, styled Zihe, was a native of Yizhou in Fengtian.
translations.idiomatic: Li Henian, styled Zihe, was a native of Yizhou in Fengtian.

sentences.zh: 道光二十五年進士，由編修改御史，轉給事中。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the twenty-fifth year of Daoguang, was transferred from compiler in the Hanlin Academy to censor, and then to supervising secretary.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in 1845, moved from a Hanlin compiler's post to the Censorate, and was later appointed a supervising secretary.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸，服除，命赴河南襄辦軍務。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his father's death; after the mourning period ended, he was ordered to proceed to Henan to assist in military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: After returning home for his father's mourning and completing the prescribed period, he was sent to Henan to help manage military affairs.

sentences.zh: 同治元年，授常鎮通海道，署河南按察使，調直隸，授布政使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tongzhi he was appointed intendant of the Chang-Zhen-Tong-Hai Circuit, acted as Henan provincial judicial commissioner, was transferred to Zhili, and was appointed provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: In 1862 he was made intendant of the Chang-Zhen-Tong-Hai Circuit, served as acting Henan judicial commissioner, transferred to Zhili, and received appointment as provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 四年，擢湖北巡撫，調河南。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was promoted to governor of Hubei, then transferred to Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he was promoted to governor of Hubei and shortly afterward transferred to Henan.

sentences.zh: 時捻匪由山東南竄，鶴年以為十餘年來賊屢擾歸、陳、南、汝間，即去而他竄，必假道於豫。

translations.literal: At the time the Nian rebels were fleeing southward from Shandong; Henian judged that for more than ten years the bandits had repeatedly harassed the region among Guizhou, Chenzhou, Nanyang, and Ruzhou — even when they left, they would flee elsewhere and necessarily pass through Henan.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels were driven south from Shandong, Henian reasoned that for more than a decade they had repeatedly struck the area between Guizhou, Chenzhou, Nanyang, and Ruzhou; whenever they moved on, they still had to cross through Henan.

sentences.zh: 乃增募兩軍各萬餘人，一曰毅軍，宋慶統之；

translations.literal: He therefore enlarged recruitment for two armies of more than ten thousand men each; one was called the Yi Army, under Song Qing's command;
translations.idiomatic: He accordingly raised two new armies of more than ten thousand men each: the Yi Army under Song Qing,

sentences.zh: 一曰嵩武軍，張曜統之；

translations.literal: one was called the Songwu Army, under Zhang Yao's command;
translations.idiomatic: and the Songwu Army under Zhang Yao,

sentences.zh: 更以馬隊屬善慶，與兩軍為犄角。

translations.literal: he further placed cavalry under Shan Qing to form pincers with the two armies.
translations.idiomatic: with Shan Qing's cavalry forming a supporting wing alongside the two main forces.

sentences.zh: 於是宋慶等軍大破張總愚睢州，鶴年親赴陳、留、杞督戰。

translations.literal: Thereupon Song Qing's army and the others routed Zhang Zongyu at Suizhou; Henian personally went to Chen, Liu, and Qi counties to supervise the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Song Qing's forces then won a major victory over Zhang Zongyu at Suizhou, while Henian went in person to Chen, Liu, and Qi counties to direct operations.

sentences.zh: 任、賴各逆复乘虛北擾，鶴年以賊踪無定，防河尤急。

translations.literal: The rebels Ren and Lai again took advantage of the opening to raid northward; Henian, judging that the bandits' movements were unpredictable, held that defending the river was especially urgent.
translations.idiomatic: Ren and Lai then seized the moment to strike north again; since rebel movements were unpredictable, Henian insisted that river defense was the top priority.

sentences.zh: 賊果犯中牟，以有備不得逞，乃於省治西決堤引水南流，擾及長垣。

translations.literal: The bandits indeed attacked Zhongmou; because preparations had been made they could not succeed, so they breached the dike west of the provincial capital to channel water southward, and the disturbance spread as far as Changyuan.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels did attack Zhongmou, but found the defenses ready and failed; they then breached a dike west of the provincial seat to divert water south, troubling Changyuan as well.

sentences.zh: 鶴年飛檄水陸各軍沿堤剿堵。

translations.literal: Henian sent urgent dispatches to land and river forces all along the dike to pursue and block the breach.
translations.idiomatic: Henian fired off urgent orders to land and river troops along the dike to drive off the rebels and seal the breach.

sentences.zh: 賊西走湖北麻城、黃岡，詔飭宋慶一軍越境會剿，殲賊無算。

translations.literal: The bandits fled west to Macheng and Huanggang in Hubei; an edict ordered Song Qing's army to cross the border for joint suppression, and countless rebels were destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled west into Macheng and Huanggang in Hubei; the court ordered Song Qing's army across the border to join the pursuit, and countless rebels were killed.

sentences.zh: 鶴年自駐許州策應，賊竄裕州，慶擊敗之。

translations.literal: Henian himself remained stationed at Xuzhou to coordinate support; the bandits fled to Yuzhou and Song Qing defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: Henian kept his headquarters at Xuzhou to coordinate the effort; when the rebels slipped into Yuzhou, Song Qing routed them.

sentences.zh: 善慶及淮軍劉銘傳大敗賊贛榆，任柱被戕死。

translations.literal: Shan Qing together with the Huai Army under Liu Mingchuan greatly defeated the bandits at Ganyu; Ren Zhu was killed in the fighting.
translations.idiomatic: Shan Qing and Liu Mingchuan of the Huai Army won a crushing victory at Ganyu, where Ren Zhu was killed.

sentences.zh: 賜鶴年頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Henian was granted the first-rank official hat finial.
translations.idiomatic: Henian was awarded the first-rank official hat finial.

sentences.zh: 七年，奉命督師出境，馳抵磁州。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was ordered to take command beyond the border and hastened to Cizhou.
translations.idiomatic: In 1868 he was ordered to lead troops outside the province and rode at once to Cizhou.

sentences.zh: 捻犯近畿，更由滑、濬等處沿河東趨。

translations.literal: The Nian rebels invaded the capital region, again moving eastward along the river through Hua and Jun and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Nian forces entered the capital region and again pressed east along the river through Hua, Jun, and neighboring areas.

sentences.zh: 坐防堵不力，再議處。

translations.literal: On account of inadequate defense and blocking he was again subject to disciplinary action.
translations.idiomatic: He was censured a second time for failing to defend and block the rebels effectively.

sentences.zh: 豫軍告捷，賞還頂戴。

translations.literal: The Henan army reported victory, and his hat finial was restored as a reward.
translations.idiomatic: After the Henan forces reported a victory, his official hat finial was returned as a reward.

sentences.zh: 總愚溺死，捻匪平，照一等軍功議敘。

translations.literal: Zongyu drowned; the Nian bandits were pacified, and he was considered for reward according to first-class military merit.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhang Zongyu drowned and the Nian rebellion was suppressed, Henian was recommended for reward on the basis of first-class military merit.

sentences.zh: 十年，擢閩浙總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was promoted to Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he was promoted to Governor-General of Fujian and Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 明年，陛見，賜紫禁城騎馬。

translations.literal: The next year he had an audience with the emperor and was granted the privilege of riding a horse within the Forbidden City.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was received in audience and granted the rare privilege of riding a horse inside the Forbidden City.

sentences.zh: 旋署福州將軍，兼署巡撫。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed acting Fuzhou general and additionally acted as governor.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made acting Fuzhou general while also serving as acting governor.

sentences.zh: 詔詢海防事宜，覆奏言：「海防之策，莫重於練兵、籌餉、制器、用人四端。

translations.literal: The throne inquired about coastal defense; in reply he memorialized: "Of policies for coastal defense, nothing is more important than the four points of training troops, securing funds, manufacturing weapons, and employing men.
translations.idiomatic: When the court asked about coastal defense, he answered in a memorial: "Coastal defense depends above all on four things: training troops, securing funds, manufacturing weapons, and appointing the right men.

sentences.zh: 四者之中，以用人為急務，而尤在專其責成。

translations.literal: Among the four, employing men is the urgent task, and above all one must assign clear responsibility.
translations.idiomatic: Of these four, staffing is the most urgent, and what matters most is to assign clear responsibility.

sentences.zh: 沿海疆臣固責無旁貸，第無統率大員，仍恐意見紛歧，臨事推諉。」

translations.literal: Coastal governors and viceroys are indeed without excuse from their responsibility, but without a supreme commanding officer there is still fear of divergent opinions and shirking at the critical moment."
translations.idiomatic: The coastal governors cannot evade their duty, but without a senior commander in overall charge, opinions will split and officials will pass blame when crisis comes."

sentences.zh: 上韙其議。

translations.literal: The emperor approved his plan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor endorsed his proposal.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，調河東河道總督，兼署河南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he was transferred to Yellow River commissioner east of the river and additionally acted as governor of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he was transferred to Governor-General of the Yellow River's Eastern Circuit and concurrently acted as governor of Henan.

sentences.zh: 七年，授河南巡撫，仍兼河督。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed governor of Henan while still holding the river commission concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he was appointed governor of Henan while retaining the river commission.

sentences.zh: 十年，坐審辦盜犯胡體安連疏抗辨，部議革職，以祝嘏恩賞降二級職銜。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, on account of repeatedly submitting memorials in defense while trying the robber Hu Ti'an, the Board recommended dismissal from office; because of the empress dowager's birthday amnesty he was demoted two ranks in nominal rank.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884 he was recommended for dismissal after repeatedly memorializing in his own defense during the trial of the robber Hu Ti'an; under the empress dowager's birthday amnesty his nominal rank was reduced by two grades instead.

sentences.zh: 十三年，署河督，疏言：「黃河分流，自宋時河決澶州，分為二派。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he acted as river commissioner and memorialized: "The Yellow River divided its flow after the breach at Dizhou in Song times, splitting into two branches.
translations.idiomatic: In 1887, while acting as river commissioner, he memorialized: "The Yellow River split after it burst at Dizhou in Song times, forming two channels.

sentences.zh: 明築黃陵岡，始合為一。

translations.literal: In the Ming, when Huangling Ridge was built up, it at last united as one.
translations.idiomatic: Not until the Ming raised Huangling Ridge did the streams reunite into one.

sentences.zh: 河性上漫則下淤，今兩路皆淤，急宜疏支河以預籌宣洩。」

translations.literal: The nature of the river is that when the upper course overflows the lower course silts up; now both routes are silted and it is urgently necessary to dredge branch channels to prepare discharge in advance."
translations.idiomatic: The river's habit is to deposit silt below whenever the upper reaches flood; now both routes are choked with silt, and branch streams must be cleared in advance to provide outlets."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 逾年，鄭工復決，發軍台效力。

translations.literal: The next year the Zhengzhou project breached again; he was sent to serve at a military penal station.
translations.idiomatic: A year later the Zhengzhou works failed again, and he was sent to serve at a military penal station.

sentences.zh: 未幾釋歸，並賞三品銜。

translations.literal: Before long he was released and sent home, and was also granted third-rank nominal rank.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon released and sent home, and was also granted third-rank nominal status.

sentences.zh: 十六年，卒。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1890.

sentences.zh: 宣統元年，開復原官。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuantong his original office was posthumously restored.
translations.idiomatic: In 1909 his original rank was posthumously restored.

sentences.zh: 鶴年有知人鑑，少與文祥同學相淬厲。

translations.literal: Henian had a discerning eye for talent; in youth he studied together with Wen Xiang and they spurred each other on.
translations.idiomatic: Henian had a keen eye for talent; as a young man he studied alongside Wen Xiang, and the two pushed each other to excel.

sentences.zh: 及居言職，嚴疏劾肅順跋扈，而奏起曾國籓於家，謂必能辦賊。

translations.literal: When he held a remonstrating office he sternly memorialized impeaching Sushun's overbearing conduct, and memorialized to recall Zeng Guofan from retirement at home, saying he would surely be able to handle the bandits.
translations.idiomatic: While serving as a remonstrating official he submitted stern memorials impeaching Sushun for arrogance and power, and urged the court to recall Zeng Guofan from retirement, declaring that Zeng alone could defeat the rebels.

sentences.zh: 拔宋慶、張曜統豫軍，後皆為名將。

translations.literal: He promoted Song Qing and Zhang Yao to command the Henan armies; both later became famous generals.
translations.idiomatic: He elevated Song Qing and Zhang Yao to lead the Henan armies, and both later became celebrated generals.

sentences.zh: 治豫久，多善政，豫人刻石頌之。

translations.literal: He governed Henan for a long time with many benevolent policies, and the people of Henan carved stone inscriptions to praise him.
translations.idiomatic: After long service in Henan he left behind many policies that benefited the people, and locals erected stone inscriptions in his praise.

sentences.zh: 始任河督，黑岡堤潰，不絕如縷。

translations.literal: When he first took up the river commission, the Heigang dike breached and hung by a thread.
translations.idiomatic: When he first became river commissioner, the Heigang dike burst and hung together by a thread.

sentences.zh: 鶴年親督工二十餘晝夜，險工克濟。

translations.literal: Henian personally supervised the work for more than twenty days and nights, and the dangerous project was successfully completed.
translations.idiomatic: Henian personally oversaw the repairs for more than twenty days and nights until the perilous stretch was secured.

sentences.zh: 德宗嘗詢李鴻藻以善治河者，鴻藻舉鶴年，上亦識前事之枉也，故再任河督。

translations.literal: Emperor Dezong once asked Li Hongzao who was good at managing rivers; Hongzao recommended Henian, and the emperor also recognized that the earlier affair had been unjust, so Henian was again appointed river commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Guangxu once asked Li Hongzao who best understood river control; Hongzao named Henian, and the emperor, recognizing that Henian had been wronged before, appointed him river commissioner again.

sentences.zh: 其卒也，豫民有流涕者。

translations.literal: At his death, there were people of Henan who wept.
translations.idiomatic: When he died, some among the people of Henan wept openly.

sentences.zh: 三子葆恂博學多文，尤知名。

translations.literal: His third son Bao Xun was learned and literary and was especially well known.
translations.idiomatic: His third son Bao Xun was widely learned and literary and became especially well known.

sentences.zh: 文彬，字質夫，納喇氏，內務府滿洲正白旗人。

translations.literal: Wen Bin, styled Zhifu, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu of the Plain White Banner attached to the Imperial Household Department.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Bin, styled Zhifu, of the Nara clan, was a Manchu bannerman of the Plain White Banner under the Imperial Household Department.

sentences.zh: 咸豐二年進士，授戶部主事。

translations.literal: He passed the jinshi examination in the second year of Xianfeng and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in 1852 and was appointed a secretary in the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 十年，以員外郎隨扈幸熱河。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, as an assistant department director he accompanied the imperial retinue to Rehe.
translations.idiomatic: In 1860, as an assistant department director, he accompanied the court to Rehe.

sentences.zh: 明年，遷郎中，出知山東沂州府。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to department director and went out to serve as prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was promoted to department director and appointed prefect of Yizhou in Shandong.

sentences.zh: 捻匪逼府城，會師攻拔賊巢，擒匪首孫化詳等。

translations.literal: Nian bandits pressed upon the prefectural city; he joined forces to storm the bandit lair and captured the bandit chiefs Sun Huaxiang and others.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian rebels threatened the prefectural seat, he combined forces to storm their stronghold and captured the rebel leaders Sun Huaxiang and others.

sentences.zh: 敘功，以道員用。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was recommended for appointment as a circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: For this service he was recommended for appointment at the circuit intendant level.

sentences.zh: 同治四年，隨布政使丁寶楨敗賊滕縣臨城驛，更繞赴東平防賊北竄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tongzhi he followed provincial treasurer Ding Baozhen in defeating bandits at Lincheng Post in Teng County, then made a detour to Dongping to guard against the bandits fleeing north.
translations.idiomatic: In 1865 he joined provincial treasurer Ding Baozhen in defeating rebels at Lincheng Post in Teng County, then swung around to Dongping to block a northern breakout.

sentences.zh: 補兗沂曹濟道，擢按察使。

translations.literal: He was appointed to the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji Circuit and was promoted provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed intendant of the Yan-Yi-Cao-Ji Circuit and promoted to provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 收復海豐，擢布政使。

translations.literal: He recovered Haifeng and was promoted provincial treasurer.
translations.idiomatic: After recovering Haifeng he was promoted to provincial treasurer.

sentences.zh: 十年，署巡撫，補漕運總督。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he acted as governor and was appointed grain transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1871 he served as acting governor and was appointed grain transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 再署巡撫，旋還任。

translations.literal: He again acted as governor, then soon returned to his regular post.
translations.idiomatic: He served again as acting governor, then soon returned to his regular commission.

sentences.zh: 光緒五年，督漕北上，因請陛見，並與河督李鶴年、巡撫週恆祺會商運河事宜，通籌河道寬深，改設運口，導引衛河，設立堤壩，繪具圖說以進。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Guangxu he supervised the grain transport northward, requested an audience, and together with river commissioner Li Henian and governor Zhou Hengqi consulted on Grand Canal matters; they comprehensively planned widening and deepening the channel, relocating the transport mouth, diverting the Wei River, establishing dikes and dams, and submitted illustrated plans.
translations.idiomatic: In 1879, while supervising the northern grain transport, he requested an audience and met with river commissioner Li Henian and governor Zhou Hengqi to discuss the Grand Canal; together they drew up a comprehensive plan to widen and deepen the waterways, relocate the transport entrance, channel in the Wei River, build dikes and sluices, and submitted illustrated proposals to the throne.

sentences.zh: 略謂：「現時北運口在張秋南八里廟，與南運口斜對，相距二十餘裡。

translations.literal: He stated in summary: "At present the northern transport mouth is at Bali Temple south of Zhangqiu, obliquely opposite the southern transport mouth, more than twenty li apart.
translations.idiomatic: In summary he argued: "At present the northern transport entrance lies at Bali Temple south of Zhangqiu, set obliquely opposite the southern entrance some twenty-odd li away.

sentences.zh: 黃流至此雖收束，而溜勢散漫，歧汊甚多。

translations.literal: When the Yellow River flow reaches here, although it is narrowed, the current disperses and branch channels are numerous.
translations.idiomatic: By the time the Yellow River reaches this point the channel has narrowed, but the current spreads out and splits into many branches.

sentences.zh: 大抵溜勢近南則北口淤墊，近北則南口淺阻。

translations.literal: Generally when the current runs nearer the south the northern mouth silts up, and when nearer the north the southern mouth becomes shallow and obstructed.
translations.idiomatic: As a rule, when the current favors the south the northern mouth silts up; when it favors the north the southern mouth grows shallow and blocked.

sentences.zh: 故漕船出南運口入黃後，必東北行二十里，至黃溜匯一之史家橋，再南行二十里，至八里廟北運口，汛水大漲，方能入運。

translations.literal: Therefore after grain boats leave the southern transport mouth and enter the Yellow River, they must travel twenty li northeast to Shijia Bridge where the Yellow current converges into one, then twenty li south to the northern transport mouth at Bali Temple, and only when flood season waters rise greatly can they enter the canal.
translations.idiomatic: Grain boats therefore leave the southern entrance, enter the Yellow River, and must run twenty li northeast to Shijia Bridge, where the Yellow River currents merge, then another twenty li south to the northern entrance at Bali Temple; only when flood season brings high water can they enter the canal.

sentences.zh: 今擬移北運口於史家橋北六里。

translations.literal: It is now proposed to move the northern transport mouth six li north of Shijia Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal is to relocate the northern transport entrance to a point six li north of Shijia Bridge.

sentences.zh: 黃河西岸，由阿城徬東堤開河一道至陶長堡，為出黃入運口門，築壩灌塘，則黃水不至奪溜，可免牽挽之難。

translations.literal: On the west bank of the Yellow River, a channel is to be opened along the eastern dike from Acheng to Taochangbao as the mouth for leaving the Yellow River and entering the canal; by building dams and irrigation ponds, Yellow River water will not seize the current and the difficulty of towing can be avoided.
translations.idiomatic: On the river's west bank a channel would be cut along the eastern dike from Acheng to Taochangbao as the gateway from the Yellow River into the canal; with dams and storage ponds in place, Yellow River water would be kept from hijacking the current and the arduous work of hauling boats would be eased.

sentences.zh: 黃、運之間，自賈工合龍後，每伏秋大雨，水無所洩，民間低地有積水數年不得耕種者，若將陂水引歸一塘，不惟蓄水濟運，又可涸复民田。

translations.literal: Between the Yellow River and the canal, since the closure of the Jia works, every summer and autumn during heavy rain the water had nowhere to drain; in low lands among the people there were areas flooded for years unable to be cultivated. If pond water were channeled into one reservoir, not only would water be stored to aid transport but farmland could be dried and restored.
translations.idiomatic: Between the Yellow and Grand Canals, ever since the Jia closure project was completed, summer and autumn rains had nowhere to go; low-lying fields had stood under water for years. Channeling that standing water into a single reservoir would store water for transport and let farmland be drained and brought back into cultivation.

sentences.zh: 運口既定，即可導引衛河。

translations.literal: Once the transport mouth is fixed, the Wei River can be diverted in.
translations.idiomatic: Once the transport entrance is fixed, the Wei River can be brought in.

sentences.zh: 自直隸元城集東三里衛河曲處鑿新河一道，經直隸之南樂、山東之朝城，至張秋南之蕭口涵洞入運。

translations.literal: From a bend in the Wei River three li east of Yuancheng Market in Zhili, a new river is to be cut passing through Nanle in Zhili and Chaocheng in Shandong, entering the canal at the Xiaokou culvert south of Zhangqiu.
translations.idiomatic: A new channel would be cut from a bend in the Wei River three li east of Yuancheng Market in Zhili, run through Nanle in Zhili and Chaocheng in Shandong, and enter the canal through the Xiaokou culvert south of Zhangqiu.

sentences.zh: 計衛高於運九丈餘，長百五十餘裡，導以濟運，勢如建瓴。

translations.literal: The Wei is calculated to be more than nine zhang higher than the canal, more than 150 li in length; directing it to aid transport would be like water pouring from a high jar.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei stands more than nine zhang above the canal along a course of over 150 li; once channeled to feed transport, the water would pour down with the force of water tipped from a high jar.

sentences.zh: 更有大小二丹水，亦可由衛濟運。

translations.literal: Moreover the Greater and Lesser Dan Rivers can also be used through the Wei to aid transport.
translations.idiomatic: The Greater and Lesser Dan Rivers could likewise be brought in through the Wei to supplement transport.

sentences.zh: 凡建四徬二壩及挑河築堤，估銀七十六萬。

translations.literal: In all, building four sluices, two dams, and dredging rivers and constructing dikes is estimated at 760,000 taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Constructing four sluice gates, two dams, dredging channels, and building dikes would cost an estimated 760,000 taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 較之借黃濟運旋挑旋淤者，相去遠矣。」

translations.literal: Compared with borrowing the Yellow River to aid transport with repeated dredging and repeated silting, the difference is vast."
translations.idiomatic: Compared with the old practice of borrowing Yellow River water for transport only to dredge again as soon as silt closed in again, the difference would be enormous."

sentences.zh: 又嘗偕兩江總督吳元炳奏复淮流故道，略謂：「淮水匯四十餘河瀦於洪澤湖，楊莊以下云梯關為入海故道，餘波入運濟漕。

translations.literal: He also once joined Governor-General Wu Yuanbing of the Two Jiangs in memorializing to restore the old course of the Huai River, stating in summary: "The Huai River gathers more than forty streams and pools in Hongze Lake; below Yangzhuang the Yunti Pass is the old route to the sea, and its remaining waters enter the canal to aid grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: He also joined Governor-General Wu Yuanbing of the Two Jiangs in a memorial to restore the Huai River's old course, arguing in summary: "More than forty rivers feed the Huai into Hongze Lake; below Yangzhuang, Yunti Pass marks the old route to the sea, and the river's remaining flow enters the canal to support grain transport.

sentences.zh: 遇旱，复蓄淮流由運河分入淮揚各徬洞，以溉民田。

translations.literal: In drought, Huai flow is again stored and distributed through sluices and culverts along the canal into Huai-Yang districts to irrigate farmland.
translations.idiomatic: In drought years stored Huai water could be sent through the canal's sluices and culverts into the Huai-Yang region to irrigate farmland.

sentences.zh: 自洪澤湖不能瀦水，張、福引河又不通暢，每遇盛漲，運河一線東堤，其勢岌岌。

translations.literal: Since Hongze Lake can no longer impound water and the Zhang and Fu diversion channels are not unobstructed, whenever floods rise the single eastern dike of the canal is in perilous condition.
translations.idiomatic: Since Hongze Lake can no longer hold back water and the Zhang and Fu diversion channels no longer run freely, every major flood puts the canal's lone eastern dike in grave danger.

sentences.zh: 儻竟衝溢，不至以里下河為壑不止。

translations.literal: If it should finally burst and overflow, it would not stop until the Lixiahe region became a ravine.
translations.idiomatic: If the dike gave way, the flood would not stop until it had turned the Lixiahe lowlands into a wasteland.

sentences.zh: 論者謂必設法束水，然與其上游議堵，何如下游深通。」

translations.literal: Commentators say water must be constrained by some method, yet rather than debating blocking upstream, why not deeply clear the lower course."
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that the water must somehow be confined, but rather than trying to block it upstream, it would be better to dredge the lower course deeply."

sentences.zh: 因條上疏濬楊莊以下舊河入海故道。

translations.literal: He therefore submitted a detailed plan to dredge the old river course below Yangzhuang to the sea.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore submitted a detailed plan to dredge the old channel below Yangzhuang that once carried the river to the sea.

sentences.zh: 未幾，卒，有詔褒錫。

translations.literal: Before long he died, and an edict praised and rewarded him.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward, and the throne issued an edict of praise and posthumous reward.

sentences.zh: 兩江總督劉坤一以文彬遺愛在民，請建專祠清江浦，允之。

translations.literal: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs, because Wen Bin's lingering benevolence remained among the people, requested that a dedicated shrine be built at Qingjiangpu, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Liu Kunyi of the Two Jiangs, citing the affection the people still bore for Wen Bin, requested a dedicated shrine at Qingjiangpu, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 子延煜，舉人，四川鹽茶道；

translations.literal: His son Yan Yu was a provincial graduate and served as Sichuan salt and tea intendant;
translations.idiomatic: His son Yan Yu, a provincial graduate, served as Sichuan salt and tea intendant;

sentences.zh: 延熙，舉人，九江知府；

translations.literal: Yan Xi was a provincial graduate and prefect of Jiujiang;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xi, a provincial graduate, was prefect of Jiujiang;

sentences.zh: 延燮，進士，武昌知縣；

translations.literal: Yan Xie was a jinshi and magistrate of Wuchang;
translations.idiomatic: Yan Xie, a jinshi, was magistrate of Wuchang;

sentences.zh: 延照，舉人，禮部員外郎。

translations.literal: Yan Zhao was a provincial graduate and assistant department director in the Ministry of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Zhao, a provincial graduate, served as assistant department director in the Ministry of Rites.

sentences.zh: 任道鎔，字筱沅，江蘇宜興人。

translations.literal: Ren Daorong, styled Xiaoyuan, was a native of Yixing in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Daorong, styled Xiaoyuan, was a native of Yixing in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 拔貢，考授教職。

translations.literal: As a selected tribute student he passed examination and was appointed to an educational post.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a tribute student, he passed examination and received appointment to an educational post.

sentences.zh: 咸豐中，在籍襄辦團練，除奉賢訓導。

translations.literal: During the Xianfeng reign, while at home he assisted in organizing local militia and was appointed Fengxian district director of studies.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xianfeng era he helped organize local militia while at home and was appointed Fengxian district director of studies.

sentences.zh: 以籌餉勞，晉秩知縣，銓當陽，多善政，調江夏。

translations.literal: For his labor in raising funds he was promoted in rank to county magistrate, was assigned to Dangyang through the board of appointment, carried out many benevolent policies, and was transferred to Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: For his work raising funds he was promoted to county magistrate, assigned to Dangyang, governed with many policies that benefited the people, and was transferred to Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，擢知順德府。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he was promoted to prefect of Shunde.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he was promoted to prefect of Shunde.

sentences.zh: 畿南匪起，行堅壁清野法，修治城堡，屢擊賊於沙河、平鄉間。

translations.literal: Bandits rose south of the capital region; he implemented the strategy of clearing the countryside and fortifying strongpoints, repaired castles, and repeatedly struck bandits between Shahe and Pingxiang.
translations.idiomatic: When bandits rose south of the capital region, he applied the strategy of clearing the countryside and fortifying strongpoints, repaired the local fortifications, and repeatedly defeated rebels between Shahe and Pingxiang.

sentences.zh: 會捻眾北犯，道鎔率練勇守沙河。

translations.literal: When Nian forces invaded northward, Daorong led militia to defend Shahe.
translations.idiomatic: When Nian forces pushed north, Daorong led local militia in the defense of Shahe.

sentences.zh: 夜與賊遇，揮眾奮擊，矛傷及身，不退，賊徐引去，晉秩道員。

translations.literal: At night he encountered the bandits, waved his troops forward in fierce attack, was wounded by a spear but did not retreat; the bandits slowly withdrew, and he was promoted in rank to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He met the rebels by night, led his men in a fierce charge, took a spear wound but held his ground; the rebels slowly withdrew, and he was promoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 洺河自廣平入，久淤塞。

translations.literal: The Ming River enters from Guangping and had long been silted and blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The Ming River, entering from Guangping, had long been choked with silt.

sentences.zh: 道鎔與鄰郡合濬，又濬郡北響水河，复民田萬餘頃。

translations.literal: Daorong joined neighboring prefectures in dredging it, and also dredged the Xiangshui River north of the prefecture, restoring more than ten thousand qing of farmland.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong joined neighboring prefectures in dredging it and also cleared the Xiangshui River north of the prefecture, restoring more than ten thousand qing of farmland.

sentences.zh: 總督曾國籓、李鴻章迭薦之。

translations.literal: Governors-general Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang repeatedly recommended him.
translations.idiomatic: Governors-general Zeng Guofan and Li Hongzhang recommended him again and again.

sentences.zh: 十一年，調保定，尋擢開歸陳許道。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was transferred to Baoding, and soon promoted to the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1872 he was transferred to Baoding and soon promoted to intendant of the Kai-Gui-Chen-Xu Circuit.

sentences.zh: 剔河工積弊，驗工料必以實。

translations.literal: He eliminated accumulated abuses in river works and verified labor and materials strictly according to fact.
translations.idiomatic: He rooted out long-standing abuses in river works and insisted that labor and materials be verified strictly on the ground.

sentences.zh: 嘗冒風雨搶護中河險工，四晝夜始定。

translations.literal: He once braved wind and rain to rush to protect the dangerous middle-river works, and only after four days and nights was the situation stabilized.
translations.idiomatic: He once worked through wind and rain to save a perilous stretch of the middle river, and only after four days and nights was the breach brought under control.

sentences.zh: 光緒元年，署按察使。

translations.literal: In the first year of Guangxu he acted as provincial judicial commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1875 he served as acting provincial judicial commissioner.

sentences.zh: 授江西按察使，省獄羈囚四百餘人，道鎔便宜訊決，三月而清。

translations.literal: He was appointed Jiangxi provincial judicial commissioner; in the provincial prison more than four hundred detained prisoners were held, and Daorong exercised discretionary authority to try and decide cases, clearing them within three months.
translations.idiomatic: Appointed Jiangxi judicial commissioner, he found more than four hundred prisoners still held in the provincial jail; exercising discretionary authority to hear cases, he cleared the backlog within three months.

sentences.zh: 四年，遷浙江布政使，調直隸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred to Zhejiang provincial treasurer and then to Zhili.
translations.idiomatic: In 1878 he was transferred to provincial treasurer of Zhejiang, then to Zhili.

sentences.zh: 直隸自軍興，州縣報銷未清，又數值謁陵大差，交代糾葛。

translations.literal: Since military operations began in Zhili, prefectural and county expense accounts had not been cleared, and there were repeated major assignments for imperial tomb visits, causing entanglements in handovers.
translations.idiomatic: Since the wars began, Zhili's prefectures and counties had left expense accounts unsettled, and repeated major assignments for imperial tomb visits had tangled successive handovers.

sentences.zh: 道鎔分別新舊案，定限清結。

translations.literal: Daorong separated new and old cases and set deadlines for clearing them.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong sorted new cases from old ones and set firm deadlines for clearing each.

sentences.zh: 裁革州縣攤捐，實發養廉銀以卹吏，勸屬縣積穀備荒。

translations.literal: He abolished levies apportioned to prefectures and counties, actually disbursed integrity-support silver to comfort officials, and urged subordinate counties to store grain against famine.
translations.idiomatic: He cut apportioned levies imposed on prefectures and counties, paid out integrity-support stipends to officials in full, and urged subordinate counties to store grain against famine.

sentences.zh: 七年，擢山東巡撫，疏陳營務廢弛，易置統將，以綠營額餉練新軍，責郡縣勤緝捕。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was promoted to governor of Shandong and memorialized that camp affairs had fallen into neglect; he replaced commanding generals, used Green Standard Army quota pay to drill new troops, and charged prefectures and counties with diligent pursuit and arrest.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he was promoted to governor of Shandong and memorialized that military discipline had slackened; he replaced commanding generals, used Green Standard pay to train new troops, and ordered prefectures and counties to pursue bandits diligently.

sentences.zh: 泰山、沂水之間，驛路崎嶇，發卒開治平坦，行旅便之。

translations.literal: Between Mount Tai and the Yi River the post road was rugged; he dispatched laborers to open and level it, to the convenience of travelers.
translations.idiomatic: Between Mount Tai and the Yi River the post road was rough; he sent laborers to cut and level it, greatly easing travel.

sentences.zh: 旋以保獎已革知府潘駿群被議，又以失察編修林國柱預報起復，被劾褫職，降道員。

translations.literal: Soon afterward he was criticized for recommending the already dismissed prefect Pan Junqun for reward; he was also impeached for failure to detect that compiler Lin Guozhu had forewarned of his own recall, was stripped of office, and demoted to circuit intendant.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon censured for recommending the dismissed prefect Pan Junqun for reward and impeached for failing to detect that compiler Lin Guozhu had tipped off his own recall; stripped of office, he was demoted to circuit intendant.

sentences.zh: 家居久之。

translations.literal: He remained at home for a long time.
translations.idiomatic: He lived in retirement for many years.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，起河道總督。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was recalled as Yellow River commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was recalled to serve as Yellow River commissioner.

sentences.zh: 故事，河督，開封、濟寧並設行署。

translations.literal: By precedent the river commissioner maintained branch offices at both Kaifeng and Jining.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent the river commissioner maintained branch offices at both Kaifeng and Jining.

sentences.zh: 自咸豐時，常駐開封，山東河事由巡撫專治。

translations.literal: Since the Xianfeng reign he had usually been stationed at Kaifeng, and Shandong river affairs were handled exclusively by the governor.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Xianfeng era the commissioner had usually been stationed at Kaifeng, while Shandong river affairs were handled by the governor alone.

sentences.zh: 至是復改議河督駐濟寧，而河南巡撫兼治河。

translations.literal: At this time it was again proposed that the river commissioner be stationed at Jining while the Henan governor would also manage river affairs.
translations.idiomatic: At this point the court again proposed stationing the river commissioner at Jining while the Henan governor would also oversee river works.

sentences.zh: 道鎔言：「官吏不相屬，則令難行，不如仍舊便。」

translations.literal: Daorong said: "When officials do not belong to the same chain of command, orders are hard to carry out; it is better to keep the old arrangement."
translations.idiomatic: Daorong argued: "When officials do not answer to the same chain of command, orders are hard to enforce; it is better to keep the old arrangement."

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The memorial was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court approved.

sentences.zh: 時河患多在下游，河督專司上游，事簡。

translations.literal: At the time river disasters were mostly in the lower course; the river commissioner was responsible only for the upper course, and affairs were simpler.
translations.idiomatic: River disasters were then mostly downstream, while the commissioner was responsible only for the upper reaches, so the post was relatively light.

sentences.zh: 道鎔務節費，歲以餘帑還司庫。

translations.literal: Daorong strove to economize and each year returned surplus funds to the provincial treasury.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong practiced strict economy and each year returned surplus funds to the provincial treasury.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，拳匪起，河南奸民乘機煽亂。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year the Boxers rose, and evil men in Henan seized the opportunity to incite disorder.
translations.idiomatic: In 1900 the Boxers rose, and ruffians in Henan seized the moment to stir up trouble.

sentences.zh: 道鎔處以鎮靜，練河標三營助省防。

translations.literal: Daorong handled matters with calm, drilled three battalions of river garrison troops to assist provincial defense.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong kept his composure and drilled three battalions of river garrison troops to help defend the province.

sentences.zh: 次年，調浙江巡撫。

translations.literal: The next year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was transferred to governor of Zhejiang.

sentences.zh: 承國威新挫後，民教相閧，案多未結，持平訊決之。

translations.literal: Coming after the recent blow to national prestige, cases of conflict between people and missionaries were many and unsettled; he tried and decided them impartially.
translations.idiomatic: After the recent humiliation of national prestige, disputes between locals and missionaries had piled up unresolved; he heard the cases and decided them evenhandedly.

sentences.zh: 籌集償款，衡其緩急，民不重困。

translations.literal: He raised indemnity funds, weighed urgency and delay, and the people were not heavily burdened.
translations.idiomatic: He raised indemnity funds and weighed what was urgent against what could wait, so the people were not crushed under the burden.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，乞病歸。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he requested leave on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: In 1902 he retired on grounds of illness.

sentences.zh: 逾三年，卒於家，年八十三。

translations.literal: After more than three years he died at home, aged eighty-three.
translations.idiomatic: More than three years later he died at home at the age of eighty-three.

sentences.zh: 許振禕，字仙屏，江西奉新人。

translations.literal: Xu Zhenyi, styled Xianping, was a native of Fengxin in Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Zhenyi, styled Xianping, was a native of Fengxin in Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 咸豐初，以拔貢生參曾國籓戎幕。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Xianfeng reign, as a selected tribute student he joined Zeng Guofan's military staff.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Xianfeng era, as a selected tribute student he joined Zeng Guofan's military staff.

sentences.zh: 迨楚軍困於江西，都邑相繼陷，振禕偕內閣中書鄧輔綸募鄉兵擊賊進賢、東鄉，旋复吉安。

translations.literal: When the Hunan army was besieged in Jiangxi and prefectures and counties fell one after another, Zhenyi together with Secretariat drafter Deng Fulun raised local militia to strike bandits in Jinxian and Dongxiang, and soon recovered Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: When Zeng's Hunan army was trapped in Jiangxi and town after town fell, Zhenyi joined Secretariat drafter Deng Fulun in raising local militia to attack rebels in Jinxian and Dongxiang, and soon recovered Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 敘功，以同知銓選。

translations.literal: His merit was recorded and he was selected for appointment as subprefect.
translations.idiomatic: For this service he was recommended for appointment as subprefect.

sentences.zh: 同治二年，成進士，授職編修，出督陝甘學政。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tongzhi he became a jinshi, was appointed compiler, and went out to serve as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu.
translations.idiomatic: In 1863 he passed the jinshi examination, was appointed a Hanlin compiler, and was sent out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu.

sentences.zh: 時河州降回复叛，而西寧諸郡回、漢民亦日相仇殺，試事久停不舉。

translations.literal: At the time surrendered Muslims in Hezhou rebelled again, and in the prefectures around Xining Muslims and Han people also daily killed one another in mutual hatred; examinations had long been suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered Muslims in Hezhou had rebelled again, and in the Xining region Muslims and Han were killing one another daily; examinations had long been suspended.

sentences.zh: 振禕始按試各郡，多錄降人子弟，補行八次歲科試，入學者數千人，回民大服。

translations.literal: Zhenyi began holding examinations in each prefecture, enrolled many sons of surrendered people, made up eight annual qualifying examinations, and several thousand entered schools; the Muslim people were greatly won over.
translations.idiomatic: Zhenyi began holding examinations in each prefecture, enrolled many sons of the surrendered population, made up eight years of missed qualifying exams, and brought several thousand students into the schools; the Muslim communities were deeply impressed.

sentences.zh: 建味經書院於涇陽，廣置書籍，以化其獷俗。

translations.literal: He built the Weijing Academy at Jingyang, broadly supplied books, to transform their rough customs.
translations.idiomatic: He founded the Weijing Academy at Jingyang and stocked it with books in hopes of softening local rough customs.

sentences.zh: 又請陝、甘分闈鄉試，各設學政，允之。

translations.literal: He also requested separate provincial examination centers for Shaanxi and Gansu and separate educational commissioners for each, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: He also petitioned for separate provincial examination centers and separate educational commissioners for Shaanxi and Gansu, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 總督左宗棠以謂邊氓長治久安之效，胥基於此。

translations.literal: Governor-General Zuo Zongtang held that the effect of long-term peace and stability among frontier people would all be based on this.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Zuo Zongtang declared that lasting peace on the frontier would depend on work like this.

sentences.zh: 父憂歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his father's death.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home to observe mourning for his father.

sentences.zh: 光緒二年，起故官。

translations.literal: In the second year of Guangxu he was recalled to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In 1876 he was recalled to his former post.

sentences.zh: 八年，授彰衛懷道，減屬縣差徭費歲二十餘萬。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed to the Zhang-Wei-Huai Circuit and reduced corvée and levy expenses of subordinate counties by more than two hundred thousand per year.
translations.idiomatic: In 1882 he was appointed intendant of the Zhang-Wei-Huai Circuit and cut corvée and levy expenses in subordinate counties by more than two hundred thousand taels a year.

sentences.zh: 豫修里河堤防，淮海各鹽區得免水患。

translations.literal: He repaired in advance inner-river dikes and defenses, and the various salt districts of Huai and Hai were spared water disasters.
translations.idiomatic: By repairing inner-river dikes in advance, he spared the salt districts of the Huai and Hai regions from flooding.

sentences.zh: 十六年，擢河東河道總督，築滎澤大壩，胡家屯、米童寨各石壩，河賴以無患。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he was promoted to Yellow River commissioner east of the river, built the great dam at Xingze, and stone dams at Hujiatun and Mitongzhai; the river relied on these to be free from disaster.
translations.idiomatic: In 1890 he was promoted to Yellow River commissioner eastward, built the great dam at Xingze and stone dams at Hujiatun and Mitongzhai, and kept the river secure.

sentences.zh: 其要尤在嚴稽察，不私財權，令七廳徑赴司庫支領，故積弊徐而工堅。

translations.literal: The key lay especially in strict inspection, not monopolizing financial authority, ordering the seven departments to draw funds directly from the provincial treasury, so accumulated abuses were gradually eliminated and the works were solid.
translations.idiomatic: His key reform was strict oversight: he refused to hoard financial authority, ordered the seven departments to draw funds directly from the provincial treasury, and so long-standing abuses faded while the works grew solid.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，遷廣東巡撫，禁賭闈姓，粵民利賴之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he was transferred to governor of Guangdong, prohibited gambling on examination surnames, and the people of Guangdong benefited and relied on this.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he was transferred to governor of Guangdong, banned gambling on examination surnames, and the people of Guangdong benefited greatly.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，裁廣東、雲南、湖北三巡撫缺，振禕調內用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year the three governorships of Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hubei were abolished, and Zhenyi was transferred to service in the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 the governorships of Guangdong, Yunnan, and Hubei were abolished, and Zhenyi was transferred to service in the capital.

sentences.zh: 乞假歸，逾年卒。

translations.literal: He requested leave and returned home; after more than a year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He took leave and returned home, and died a little over a year later.

sentences.zh: 附祀江蘇、河南曾國籓祠。

translations.literal: He was attached for joint sacrifice in the Zeng Guofan shrines of Jiangsu and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He was given a place for joint sacrifice in the Zeng Guofan shrines in Jiangsu and Henan.

sentences.zh: 吳大澂，字清卿，江蘇吳縣人。

translations.literal: Wu Dacheng, styled Qingqing, was a native of Wu County in Jiangsu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Dacheng, styled Qingqing, was a native of Wu County in Jiangsu.

sentences.zh: 同治元年秋，彗星見西北，詔求直言。

translations.literal: In the autumn of the first year of Tongzhi a comet appeared in the northwest, and an edict sought forthright speech.
translations.idiomatic: In the autumn of 1862 a comet appeared in the northwest, and the throne called for candid memorials.

sentences.zh: 大澂方為諸生，入都應京兆試。

translations.literal: Dacheng was then a common student and entered the capital to take the metropolitan district examination.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng was then a common student and had come to the capital for the metropolitan district examination.

sentences.zh: 上書言：「致治之本，在興儉舉廉，不言理財而財自裕。

translations.literal: He submitted a memorial saying: "The root of good government lies in promoting frugality and elevating integrity; without speaking of managing finances, finances of themselves become ample.
translations.idiomatic: He submitted a memorial arguing: "Good government rests on promoting frugality and elevating integrity; speak nothing of finance management, and the treasury will fill of itself.

sentences.zh: 若專務掊克，罔恤民艱，其國必敝。」

translations.literal: If one devotes oneself solely to extortion and ignores the people's hardship, the state will surely be exhausted."
translations.idiomatic: If officials devote themselves only to extortion and ignore the people's hardship, the state will surely be ruined."

sentences.zh: 後六年成進士，授編修。

translations.literal: Six years later he became a jinshi and was appointed compiler.
translations.idiomatic: Six years later he passed the jinshi examination and was appointed a Hanlin compiler.

sentences.zh: 穆宗大婚典禮隆縟，疏請裁減繁費，直聲震朝右。

translations.literal: The marriage ceremonies of Emperor Muzong were lavish and elaborate; he memorialized requesting reduction of excessive expenses, and his forthright reputation shook the court.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Tongzhi's wedding ceremonies grew lavish beyond measure, he memorialized to cut excessive costs, and his blunt honesty shook the court.

sentences.zh: 出為陝甘學政，奏以倉頡列祀典，允之。

translations.literal: He went out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu and memorialized to place Cangjie in the sacrificial canon, and this was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Sent out as educational commissioner of Shaanxi and Gansu, he memorialized to add Cangjie, legendary inventor of writing, to the state sacrificial canon, and the court approved.

sentences.zh: 又薦諸生賀瑞麟、楊樹椿篤志正學，給瑞麟國子監學正銜，樹椿翰林院待詔銜，士風為之一變。

translations.literal: He also recommended the common students He Ruilin and Yang Shuchun for their steadfast devotion to orthodox learning; Ruilin was given the title of director of studies at the Imperial Academy, Shuchun the title of Hanlin awaiting-edict, and scholarly custom was thereby transformed.
translations.idiomatic: He also recommended common students He Ruilin and Yang Shuchun for their steadfast devotion to orthodox learning; Ruilin received the title of Imperial Academy director of studies and Shuchun the Hanlin awaiting-edict title, and scholarly manners changed markedly.

sentences.zh: 時詔修頤和園，大澂復言時事艱難，請停止工作。

translations.literal: At the time an edict ordered repairs to the Summer Palace; Dacheng again spoke that the times were difficult and requested that the work be stopped.
translations.idiomatic: When the court ordered repairs to the Summer Palace, Dacheng again argued that times were hard and asked that the work be halted.

sentences.zh: 疏入，留中。

translations.literal: The memorial was submitted and kept within the palace.
translations.idiomatic: The memorial was submitted and left unanswered.

sentences.zh: 光緒三年，山、陝大饑，奉命襄辦賑務。

translations.literal: In the third year of Guangxu Shanxi and Shaanxi suffered great famine; he was ordered to assist in relief work.
translations.idiomatic: In 1877, when Shanxi and Shaanxi were stricken by severe famine, he was ordered to help manage relief.

sentences.zh: 躬履災區查勘，全活甚眾。

translations.literal: He personally went through the disaster area to inspect, and a great many were wholly saved.
translations.idiomatic: He went in person through the disaster zone to inspect conditions and saved a great many lives.

sentences.zh: 左宗棠、曾國荃、李鴻章等交章論薦。

translations.literal: Zuo Zongtang, Zeng Guoquan, Li Hongzhang, and others submitted memorials in turn recommending him.
translations.idiomatic: Zuo Zongtang, Zeng Guoquan, Li Hongzhang, and others submitted memorial after memorial recommending him.

sentences.zh: 四年，授河北道。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed to the Hebei Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In 1878 he was appointed intendant of the Hebei Circuit.

sentences.zh: 時比歲薦飢，貧民減價鬻田，十不得一。

translations.literal: At the time famine recurred year after year; poor people sold land at reduced prices, getting less than one-tenth of its value.
translations.idiomatic: Famine had struck year after year, and poor farmers sold land at a fraction of its worth, often for less than a tenth of the fair price.

sentences.zh: 巡撫塗宗瀛飭荒歲賤價之田準取贖，然往往為勢家所持，以故失業者眾。

translations.literal: Governor Tu Zongying ordered that land sold cheaply in famine years could be redeemed at the sale price, yet it was often held by powerful families, and for this reason many lost their livelihoods.
translations.idiomatic: Governor Tu Zongying ordered that land sold cheaply in famine years could be redeemed at the sale price, but powerful families often blocked redemption, leaving many farmers landless.

sentences.zh: 惟大澂能判決如巡撫恉。

translations.literal: Only Dacheng was able to decide cases according to the governor's intent.
translations.idiomatic: Only Dacheng enforced the governor's policy as intended.

sentences.zh: 六年，詔給三品卿銜，隨吉林將軍銘​​安辦理西北邊防。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he was granted third-rank ministerial rank and followed Jilin general Ming'an in managing northwestern frontier defense.
translations.idiomatic: In 1880 he was granted third-rank ministerial status and accompanied Jilin general Ming'an in managing northwestern frontier defense.

sentences.zh: 大澂週曆要隘，始知琿春黑頂子地久為俄人侵占。

translations.literal: Dacheng toured the strategic passes in turn and first learned that the Hundingzi lands of Hunchun had long been occupied by Russians.
translations.idiomatic: Touring the strategic passes, Dacheng discovered that the Hundingzi territory of Hunchun had long been occupied by Russia.

sentences.zh: 因請頒舊界圖，將定期與俄官抗議，未得旨。

translations.literal: He therefore requested issuance of the old boundary map and planned to set a date to protest with Russian officials, but received no imperial approval.
translations.idiomatic: He petitioned for the old boundary maps and planned to lodge a formal protest with Russian officials, but received no approval from the throne.

sentences.zh: 時有韓效忠者，登州人，傭於復州侯氏。

translations.literal: At the time there was one Han Xiaozhong, a native of Dengzhou, employed by the Hou family of Fuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was a man named Han Xiaozhong, a native of Dengzhou who had worked as a hired hand for the Hou family of Fuzhou.

sentences.zh: 負博進，遁往吉林夾皮溝。

translations.literal: He owed gambling debts and fled to Jiapigou in Jilin.
translations.idiomatic: Deep in gambling debt, he fled to Jiapigou in Jilin.

sentences.zh: 地產金，在寧古塔、三姓東，萬山環繞，廣袤七八百里。

translations.literal: The place produced gold; it lay east of Ningguta and Sanxing, surrounded by myriad mountains, seven or eight hundred li in breadth.
translations.idiomatic: The area produced gold; east of Ningguta and Sanxing, it lay ringed by mountains and stretched seven or eight hundred li across.

sentences.zh: 流冗嘯聚其中，亡慮四五萬，咸受效忠約束。

translations.literal: Vagrants gathered there in bands, estimated at forty or fifty thousand, all subject to Xiaozhong's control.
translations.idiomatic: Vagrants gathered there in bands, perhaps forty or fifty thousand strong, all under Xiaozhong's control.

sentences.zh: 效忠嚴而不擾，眾服其公允，屢抗大軍不出。

translations.literal: Xiaozhong was strict but did not harass; the multitude submitted to his fairness, and repeatedly resisted imperial armies without coming out.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong ruled strictly but fairly, and his followers accepted his authority; they had repeatedly held off imperial armies without surrendering.

sentences.zh: 大澂單騎抵其巢，留宿三日，勸效忠出，效忠猶豫，意難之。

translations.literal: Dacheng rode alone to their lair, stayed three nights, and urged Xiaozhong to come out; Xiaozhong hesitated and found the matter difficult.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng rode alone into their stronghold, stayed three days, and urged Xiaozhong to surrender; Xiaozhong hesitated, troubled by the request.

sentences.zh: 大澂曰：「我不疑若，若乃疑我耶？」

translations.literal: Dacheng said: "I do not doubt you — do you then doubt me?"
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng said: "I do not doubt you — do you doubt me?"

sentences.zh: 對曰：「非敢疑公。

translations.literal: He replied: "I would not dare doubt Your Excellency.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozhong replied: "I would not dare doubt you, sir.

sentences.zh: 某負罪久，萬一主兵者執前事為罪。

translations.literal: I have long borne guilt; if by chance the military commander should treat my past deeds as crimes.
translations.idiomatic: I have been guilty a long time; if the commander should treat my past deeds as crimes,

sentences.zh: 某死不恨，辜公意奈何？」

translations.literal: I would not resent death, but how could I fail Your Excellency's intent?"
translations.idiomatic: my death would not trouble me — but how could I fail your purpose?"

sentences.zh: 大澂挺以自任，遂與效忠出，奏給五品頂戴，子七品，孫登舉有平寇功，授參將。

translations.literal: Dacheng pledged himself to take responsibility, and thereupon came out with Xiaozhong; a memorial granted Xiaozhong fifth-rank hat finial, his son seventh rank, and his grandson Dengju, for merit in pacifying bandits, was appointed brigade commander.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng pledged to take personal responsibility, and Xiaozhong came out with him; the court granted Xiaozhong a fifth-rank hat finial, his son seventh rank, and his grandson Dengju, credited with pacifying the bandits, the rank of brigade commander.

sentences.zh: 七年，授太僕寺卿。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was appointed minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: In 1881 he was appointed minister of the Court of the Imperial Stud.

sentences.zh: 法越事起，會辦北洋軍務，駐防樂亭、昌黎。

translations.literal: When the Franco-Vietnamese affair arose, he was assigned to assist in Beiyang military affairs and garrisoned Leting and Changli.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sino-French conflict broke out, he was assigned to assist in Beiyang military affairs and garrisoned Leting and Changli.

sentences.zh: 十年，遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: In 1884 he was transferred to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 俄，命使朝鮮，定其內亂，鹽運使續昌副之。

translations.literal: Soon he was ordered as envoy to Korea to settle its internal disorder, with salt transport commissioner Xuchang as deputy.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward he was sent as envoy to Korea to settle its internal disorder, with salt transport commissioner Xuchang as his deputy.

sentences.zh: 至則日本使​​臣井上馨避不肯見，而挾朝鮮左議政金宏集於議政院，索償兵費三十萬。

translations.literal: Upon arrival the Japanese minister Inoue Kaoru avoided him and refused to meet, but seized Korean Left State Councillor Kim Hong-jip at the State Council and demanded three hundred thousand taels in military expenses.
translations.idiomatic: On arrival he found the Japanese minister Inoue Kaoru avoiding him and refusing an audience, while holding Korean Left State Councillor Kim Hong-jip at the State Council and demanding three hundred thousand taels in military expenses.

sentences.zh: 大澂謂續昌曰：「是蔑我也！」

translations.literal: Dacheng said to Xuchang: "This is contempt for me!"
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng said to Xuchang: "This is an insult to me!"

sentences.zh: 立率兵至議政院，排闥入，責數宏集：「柄國敗壞國事。

translations.literal: He immediately led troops to the State Council, pushed open the doors and entered, and rebuked Hong-jip: "Wielding power you have ruined state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He immediately led troops to the State Council, forced the doors open, and rebuked Kim Hong-jip: "In wielding power you have ruined the country's affairs.

sentences.zh: 今定約稍不慎，便滋異日紛，非所以靖國也。」

translations.literal: If the agreement now made is even slightly careless, it will breed future troubles — this is not the way to pacify the state."
translations.idiomatic: If this agreement is handled carelessly, it will breed future troubles — that is no way to restore peace to the country."

sentences.zh: 宏集唯唯，井上馨亦氣懾，減索兵費十一萬而去。

translations.literal: Hong-jip assented repeatedly; Inoue Kaoru was also cowed in spirit, reduced the demand to one hundred ten thousand, and departed.
translations.idiomatic: Kim Hong-jip could only assent; Inoue Kaoru was intimidated as well, cut his demand to one hundred ten thousand taels, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一年，詔赴吉林，會同副都統伊克唐阿與俄使勘侵界，即所侵琿春黑頂子地也。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was ordered to proceed to Jilin, together with vice commander-in-chief Yike Tang'a and Russian envoys to survey the encroached boundary — namely the encroached Hundingzi lands of Hunchun.
translations.idiomatic: In 1885 he was ordered to Jilin to join vice commander-in-chief Yike Tang'a and Russian envoys in surveying the encroached border — the Hundingzi territory of Hunchun.

sentences.zh: 遂援咸豐十一年舊界圖立碑五座，建銅柱，自篆銘曰：「疆域有表國有維，此柱可立不可移。」

translations.literal: He then relied on the old boundary map of the eleventh year of Xianfeng to erect five steles and build a bronze pillar, personally carving the inscription: "Boundaries have markers; the state has pillars of support — this pillar may be erected but not moved."
translations.idiomatic: Following the old boundary map of 1861, he erected five steles and a bronze pillar, personally inscribing it: "Boundaries have their markers; the state has its pillars — this pillar may stand but must not be moved."

sentences.zh: 於是侵界復歸中國，而船之出入圖們江者亦卒以通航無阻。

translations.literal: Thereupon the encroached boundary was restored to China, and vessels entering and leaving the Tumen River also finally passed without obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: The encroached territory was restored to China, and vessels on the Tumen River at last passed freely without obstruction.

sentences.zh: 十二年，擢廣東巡撫。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was promoted to governor of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In 1886 he was promoted to governor of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 葡萄牙侵界至澳門香山。

translations.literal: Portugal encroached on the boundary as far as Xiangshan of Macau.
translations.idiomatic: Portugal had encroached on the border as far as Xiangshan near Macau.

sentences.zh: 總署與立約通商，畫澳門歸葡轄。

translations.literal: The Zongli Yamen made a treaty for trade and drew Macau under Portuguese jurisdiction.
translations.idiomatic: The Zongli Yamen negotiated a trade treaty that placed Macau under Portuguese jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 大澂持不可，條上駁議，不報。

translations.literal: Dacheng held this unacceptable and submitted a detailed rebuttal; no response was given.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng objected and submitted a detailed rebuttal, but received no response.

sentences.zh: 十四年，鄭州河再決，上震怒，褫河督李鶴年職，以大澂代之。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year the Zhengzhou river breached again; the emperor was greatly angered, stripped river commissioner Li Henian of office, and replaced him with Dacheng.
translations.idiomatic: In 1888 the Zhengzhou breach opened again; the emperor was furious, dismissed river commissioner Li Henian, and replaced him with Dacheng.

sentences.zh: 是年冬，河工合龍，大澂力居多。

translations.literal: That winter the river works were closed; Dacheng's effort was foremost.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the breach was closed, and Dacheng's contribution was the largest.

sentences.zh: 大澂盛負時譽，會海軍議起，以醇親王奕枻為總理。

translations.literal: Dacheng bore great contemporary reputation; when discussion of a navy arose, Prince Chun Yixuan was made superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng enjoyed great contemporary renown; when plans for a navy were raised, Prince Chun Yixuan was placed in charge.

sentences.zh: 大澂素與王善，治河功成，實授河道總督，加頭品頂戴。

translations.literal: Dacheng had long been on good terms with the prince; when river control was successfully completed he was substantively appointed Yellow River commissioner and granted the first-rank hat finial.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng had long been on good terms with the prince; after the river works succeeded he was formally appointed Yellow River commissioner and granted the first-rank hat finial.

sentences.zh: 大澂遂疏請尊崇醇親王稱號禮節。

translations.literal: Dacheng then memorialized requesting elevated titles and ceremonial honors for Prince Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng then memorialized requesting elevated titles and ceremonial honors for Prince Chun.

sentences.zh: 疏入，孝欽顯皇后震怒，出醇親王元年所上預杜妄論疏頒示天下。

translations.literal: When the memorial was submitted, Empress Dowager Cixi was greatly angered and issued for publication throughout the realm the memorial Prince Chun had submitted in his first year to forestall reckless talk.
translations.idiomatic: When the memorial arrived, Empress Dowager Cixi was furious and had Prince Chun's own memorial from his first year in office — written to forestall reckless speculation — published throughout the empire.

sentences.zh: 大澂幾得嚴譴，以母喪歸，乃已。

translations.literal: Dacheng nearly received severe punishment, but returned home on his mother's death, and the matter then ended.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng nearly faced severe punishment, but returned home for his mother's mourning, and the affair ended there.

sentences.zh: 十八年，授湖南巡撫。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year he was appointed governor of Hunan.
translations.idiomatic: In 1892 he was appointed governor of Hunan.

sentences.zh: 朝鮮東學黨之亂也，日本與中國開釁，朝議皆主戰。

translations.literal: When the Donghak rebellion broke out in Korea, Japan and China opened hostilities, and court opinion overwhelmingly favored war.
translations.idiomatic: When the Donghak rebellion erupted in Korea, Japan and China went to war, and court opinion overwhelmingly favored fighting.

sentences.zh: 大澂因自請率湘軍赴前敵，優詔允之。

translations.literal: Dacheng thereupon volunteered to lead Hunan troops to the front, and a gracious edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng volunteered to lead Hunan troops to the front, and the throne graciously approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，出關會諸軍規复海城，而日本由間道取牛莊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year he passed out of the pass to join the armies planning to recover Haicheng, while Japan took Niuzhuang by a side route.
translations.idiomatic: In 1895 he marched beyond the pass to join the armies planning to retake Haicheng, while Japanese forces seized Niuzhuang by a back route.

sentences.zh: 魏光燾往禦，戰不利。

translations.literal: Wei Guangtao went to resist; the battle went badly.
translations.idiomatic: Wei Guangtao went out to meet them, but the battle went badly.

sentences.zh: 李光久馳救之，亦敗，僅以數騎免。

translations.literal: Li Guangji rushed to rescue and was also defeated, escaping with only a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Li Guangji raced to the rescue and was defeated as well, escaping with only a handful of horsemen.

sentences.zh: 大澂憤湘軍盡覆，拔劍欲自裁，王同愈在側，格阻之，同愈以編修參大澂軍事也。

translations.literal: Dacheng, enraged that the Hunan army was entirely destroyed, drew his sword intending suicide; Wang Tongyu was at his side and blocked him—Tongyu was serving as compiler on Dacheng's military staff.
translations.idiomatic: Enraged that the Hunan army had been wiped out, Dacheng drew his sword to kill himself; Wang Tongyu, who was serving on his staff as a Hanlin compiler, was at his side and stopped him.

sentences.zh: 光燾請申軍法，大澂歎曰：「餘實不能軍，當自請嚴議。」

translations.literal: Guangtao requested application of military law; Dacheng sighed and said: "I truly cannot command troops; I ought to request severe punishment myself."
translations.idiomatic: Guangtao asked that military law be applied; Dacheng sighed and said: "I truly cannot command troops; I should request severe punishment myself."

sentences.zh: 退入關，奉革職留任之旨。

translations.literal: He withdrew inside the pass and received an order of dismissal from office but retention of duties.
translations.idiomatic: He withdrew inside the pass and received orders dismissing him from office while keeping him temporarily at his post.

sentences.zh: 乃還湖南，尋命開缺。

translations.literal: He then returned to Hunan; soon he was ordered to vacate the post.
translations.idiomatic: He returned to Hunan, and soon afterward was ordered to vacate the governorship.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，复降旨革職永不敘用。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year an edict again dismissed him from office and barred him forever from reappointment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1898 a new edict dismissed him from office and barred him permanently from further appointment.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，卒，年六十八。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year he died, aged sixty-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in 1902 at the age of sixty-eight.

sentences.zh: 大澂善篆籀，罷官後，貧甚，售書畫、古銅器自給。

translations.literal: Dacheng was skilled in seal and bronze scripts; after dismissal from office he was extremely poor and sold calligraphy, paintings, and ancient bronzes to support himself.
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng was accomplished in seal and bronze script; after leaving office he was desperately poor and sold calligraphy, paintings, and ancient bronzes to support himself.

sentences.zh: 著有古籀補、古玉圖考、權衡度量考、恆軒古金錄、齋詩文集。

translations.literal: He authored Supplement to Ancient Seal Script, Inquiry into Ancient Jade, Inquiry into Weights and Measures, Hengxuan's Record of Ancient Bronzes, and collected prose and poetry.
translations.idiomatic: His works include Supplement to Ancient Seal Script, Inquiry into Ancient Jade, Inquiry into Weights and Measures, Hengxuan's Record of Ancient Bronzes, and a collected volume of prose and poetry.

sentences.zh: 論曰：河患日棘，而河臣但歲慶安瀾，即為奇績，久未聞統全局而防永患，求治難矣。

translations.literal: Commentary says: River disasters grow daily more pressing, yet river officials need only celebrate each year's calm waters as a remarkable achievement; for long one has not heard of coordinating the whole situation to guard against lasting disaster—seeking good governance is hard indeed.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: River disasters grow worse by the day, yet river officials need only celebrate each year's calm waters as a remarkable feat; for years no one has tried to coordinate the whole system to prevent lasting catastrophe—genuine reform is hard to achieve.

sentences.zh: 鶴年以善治河稱，文彬論治河改運口，复淮流，亦頗有識。

translations.literal: Henian was known for skill in managing rivers; Wen Bin's discussion of changing the transport mouth and restoring Huai flow also showed considerable insight.
translations.idiomatic: Henian was famed for river control; Wen Bin's proposals to relocate the transport entrance and restore the Huai River also showed real insight.

sentences.zh: 道鎔剔河工積弊，務節減，振禕督工嚴，盡革中飽，尤以勤廉者，皆足收一時之效，然徒治標，非治本計也。

translations.literal: Daorong eliminated accumulated abuses in river works and strove to economize; Zhenyi supervised works strictly and thoroughly reformed embezzlement, especially through diligence and integrity—they all achieved timely effects, yet these were merely treating symptoms, not a fundamental cure.
translations.idiomatic: Daorong rooted out long-standing abuses and practiced strict economy; Zhenyi supervised works rigorously and stamped out embezzlement through diligence and integrity—all achieved useful short-term results, but these were palliatives, not a fundamental cure.

sentences.zh: 大澂治河有名，而好言兵，才氣自喜，卒以虛憍敗，惜哉！

translations.literal: Dacheng was famous for managing rivers, yet loved to talk of military matters, was pleased with his own talent, and in the end failed through empty arrogance—what a pity!
translations.idiomatic: Dacheng was famous for river control, yet loved to talk of military affairs, took pride in his own talent, and in the end was ruined by empty arrogance—a pity indeed!
